commitMessage: governance: re-issue the R7 historical permanence consumption record

cohortSelfExclusion.reason: The consumption record cannot hash its own final bytes; its identity is bound by the authority and manifest instead.

cohort.reason: Re-issue the R7_HISTORICAL_PERMANENCE consumption record, which was malformed at birth and failed VERIFY_PROGRAM_CONSUMPTION with CONSUMPTION_COHORT_COUNT_MISMATCH: cohortPathCount must equal its manifest path count of six, while the cohort array legitimately carries five entries because the record is self-excluded. A consumption record is named by no other cohort and therefore has no canonical predecessor, so it cannot be edited in place; it is withdrawn and re-issued. It was never committed, so no history is rewritten. The re-issued record describes the same transaction and certifies the final bytes of that cohort.
Single-use successor LOCAL_EXPLICIT_AUTHORITY for the consumption re-issue; no already-consumed authority is reused.
Exact finite four-path cohort with declared per-path pre-state; no wildcard and no directory blanket.
